rows.text: Norges Bank's Executive Board has decided to keep the key policy rate unchanged at 1.5 percent.
Norges Bank's Executive Board has decided to keep the key policy rate unchanged at 1.5 percent.
"Inflation in September was lower than expected, but at the same time the krone has depreciated since the previous monetary policy meeting.
